verdict.rationale: Sill documents a non-interactive Terminal install of the Mac app via its own Homebrew tap (`brew install --cask saffsanity/sill/sill`). That command could be scripted across machines, which approximates a silent install. Nothing in the evidence covers fleet deployment, preset configuration, or management tooling; pairing is per device and settings are changed by hand in the app. Missing for 10: MSI/PKG or MDM deployment docs, preset or managed configuration (e.g. configuration profiles or managed preferences), explicit silent-install guidance for fleets, iOS/iPadOS client mass deployment, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can mass-deploy the client with preset configuration through MSI, MDM, or a documented silent install

citations.quote: brew install --cask saffsanity/sill/sill in Terminal installs the same Sill.dmg from Sill’s own tap.
